title: Issued SCHC fragment wires bypass session expiry and clock fail-stop
description: SchcSessionManager.consume_fragment_wire() checks record.active but never advances/validates the session clock or expires records. An initial/retransmission _IssuedFragmentWire retained past idle_expires_at can still be consumed and transmitted without any timer maintenance call; likewise a now-NaN/regressed clock is not observed on this authority path, undermining y4vw's fail-stop guarantee. Under the manager lock, validate the shared clock and expire due records before consuming the one-use capability; stale/expired wires must return false, clock failures must revoke/unpin through the terminal cleanup. Add exact expiry-boundary and invalid-clock wire-consumption regressions.
